description: This file defines the Profile class within the Twig\Profiler namespace. The class is used for profiling Twig templates, including tracking durations, start/end times, memory usage, and hierarchical profiling data. It implements iterator and serialization interfaces to manage collections of profiles and serializable state.

classes.name: Profile
classes.description: Represents a profiling data structure for Twig templates, including hierarchical relationships and performance metrics.

methods.name: getTemplate
methods.description: Returns the template name associated with this profile.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of profile (e.g., ROOT, block, template, macro).

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name identifier of the profile.

methods.name: isRoot
methods.description: Checks if the profile is of type ROOT.

methods.name: isTemplate
methods.description: Checks if the profile is of type TEMPLATE.

methods.name: isBlock
methods.description: Checks if the profile is of type BLOCK.

methods.name: isMacro
methods.description: Checks if the profile is of type MACRO.

methods.name: getProfiles
methods.description: Retrieves child profiles associated with this profile.

methods.name: addProfile
methods.description: Adds a child profile.

methods.name: getDuration
methods.description: Calculates the duration of the profile execution in microseconds.

methods.name: getStartTime
methods.description: Provides the start time in microseconds.

methods.name: getEndTime
methods.description: Provides the end time in microseconds.

methods.name: getMemoryUsage
methods.description: Returns the memory usage in bytes during profiling.

methods.name: getPeakMemoryUsage
methods.description: Returns the peak memory usage in bytes.

methods.name: enter
methods.description: Begins profiling by recording start metrics.

methods.name: leave
methods.description: Ends profiling by recording end metrics.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the profiling data.

methods.name: getIterator
methods.description: Provides an iterator for child profiles.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the profile object.

methods.name: unserialize
methods.description: Unserializes data into the profile object.

methods.name: __serialize
methods.description: Returns serializable array representation of the profile.

methods.name: __unserialize
methods.description: Restores profile state from serialized data.
